name: Cyberspace EDEN
main_effect:
While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your Digimon with the [CS] trait get +2000 DP.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower card with the [CS] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
